user_request: Design an NPU for accelerating matrix-vector multiplication in neural-network inference. Use 16 parallel INT8 multiply-accumulate units, INT32 accumulators, optional bias addition, and selectable ReLU activation. The accelerator should accept input data and return results through ready/valid streaming interfaces.

rtl_context.user_request: Design an NPU for accelerating matrix-vector multiplication in neural-network inference. Use 16 parallel INT8 multiply-accumulate units, INT32 accumulators, optional bias addition, and selectable ReLU activation. The accelerator should accept input data and return results through ready/valid streaming interfaces.

design.name: mv_npu_rv16_int8
design.description: Matrix-vector inference accelerator using 16 parallel INT8 MAC lanes, INT32 accumulation, optional INT32 bias add, optional ReLU, ready/valid streaming I/O.

operations.name: op_decode_command
operations.semantics: Latch one command packet on cmd channel transfer; defines one job parameters and feature enables.

operations.name: op_load_vector
operations.semantics: Load input vector elements x[0..N-1] into local vector SRAM in ascending index order, using N from obj_job_config.

operations.name: op_compute_row_dot
operations.semantics: For each row r in 0..M-1, compute sum_{k=0..N-1}(W[r,k]*x[k]) with INT8 signed multiply and INT32 signed accumulation. Products are exact 16-bit signed then sign-extended to INT32 before add. Accumulation wraps modulo 2^32 (two's complement).

operations.name: op_optional_bias
operations.semantics: If bias_enable=1, y_pre = row_accum + bias[r] using INT32 signed add with wrap modulo 2^32; else y_pre = row_accum.

operations.name: op_optional_relu
operations.semantics: If relu_enable=1, y = max(0,y_pre) in INT32 signed domain; else y = y_pre.

data_types.name: dt_int8
data_types.conversion_semantics: No implicit conversion on transport; compute sign-extends for multiply inputs.

dimensions.name: dim_M
dimensions.semantic: number of matrix rows / output elements per job; runtime legal range 1..MAX_M bounded by parameter MAX_M

dimensions.name: dim_N
dimensions.semantic: number of matrix columns / vector length per job; runtime legal range 1..MAX_N bounded by parameter MAX_N

parameters.name: MAX_N
parameters.description: compile-time bound for runtime N and vector SRAM depth

parameters.name: LANES
parameters.description: parallel INT8 MAC lanes (fixed by requirement)

parameters.name: MAT_DATA_W
parameters.description: matrix stream payload width, 16 INT8 per beat

parameters.name: VEC_DATA_W
parameters.description: vector stream payload width, 1 INT8 per beat

parameters.name: BIAS_DATA_W
parameters.description: bias stream payload width, 1 INT32 per beat

parameters.name: OUT_DATA_W
parameters.description: output stream payload width, 1 INT32 per beat

compute.organization: single-engine SIMD dot-product datapath with 16 parallel MAC lanes and one shared INT32 accumulator
compute.dataflow: row-stationary accumulation; vector preloaded once per job, matrix streamed row-major during compute
compute.parallelism: 16-way inner-product parallelism across k dimension chunks of 16
compute.scheduling: phased: command load -> vector preload -> per-row compute (stream matrix chunks) -> optional bias consume -> optional ReLU -> output emit; no overlap between jobs

storage.name: vec_sram
storage.access_pattern: write sequential during vector load; read LANES elements per compute iteration via 16-bank organization
storage.port_requirements: 1 write path + 16 parallel read lanes per cycle during compute
storage.implementation_hint: banked distributed RAM or register-file banks
storage.reuse_semantics: reused for all M rows within job
storage.lifetime: from end of vector load until job completion

storage.name: row_acc_reg
storage.access_pattern: reset per row then accumulate each compute cycle

storage.name: cfg_regs
storage.access_pattern: write on cmd accept, read throughout job

pipeline.responsibility: ready/valid handshakes and payload capture for cmd/vector/matrix/bias
pipeline.stall_behavior: when downstream not ready, deassert ready and hold state

pipeline.responsibility: 16 signed INT8 multiplies for current matrix chunk and vector chunk
sum 16 products and add into INT32 row accumulator
pipeline.valid_behavior: update accumulator once per accepted chunk

pipeline.responsibility: optional bias add, optional ReLU, output ready/valid drive
pipeline.valid_behavior: emit one output per completed row when out_ready||!out_valid

control.state_progression: IDLE->LOAD_VEC->COMPUTE_ROWS->DONE then back IDLE after final output handshake
control.error_behavior: protocol/runtime error raises sticky error flag and halts new progress; errors: cmd fields out of range, unexpected stream length mismatch, bias stream present when disabled or absent when enabled
control.error_recovery: assert soft reset input rst_n low then high to clear error and return IDLE

reset.required_state: FSM IDLE, counters zero, valid outputs low, ready low until idle-init complete, sticky error cleared

architecture_contract.latency_model: Per job cycles = 1 cmd + N vector-load + M*ceil(N/16) matrix-compute-chunks + M output; plus M bias input cycles when bias_enable=1. Throughput inside a row is one 16-element chunk per cycle after pipeline fill. Final chunk uses lane_valid_mask for N mod 16.
architectural_invariants: One vector element transferred per vec beat
Sixteen matrix INT8 elements packed per matrix beat
Output order strictly row index ascending
Bias stream consumed iff bias_enable=1, exactly M beats
open_assumptions: Single outstanding job; next command accepted only after current job completes
Host provides exact transfer counts per command: vector N, matrix M*ceil(N/16), bias M if enabled
Matrix stream packs lanes as payload bits [8*i+7:8*i]=element k_base+i where k_base=16*k_chunk_idx; invalid lanes on final partial chunk ignored by lane_valid_mask
Missing k elements beyond N in final chunk are treated as zero contribution
No separate clear/error-ack interface; reset is only recovery

channels.name: cmd_chan
channels.ordering: must arrive before any job data streams

channels.name: vec_chan
channels.framing: exactly N beats, one INT8 per beat

channels.name: mat_chan
channels.framing: exactly M*ceil(N/16) beats, 16 INT8 packed per beat

channels.name: bias_chan
channels.framing: if bias_enable=1 exactly M beats else 0 beats

channels.name: out_chan
channels.framing: exactly M beats, one INT32 per beat

signals.name: mat_data
signals.semantic: 16 packed INT8 matrix elements per beat

global_handshake_rules.transfer_condition: A channel transfer occurs only when ready && valid on same rising edge.
global_handshake_rules.stall_behavior: While valid=1 and ready=0, source must hold payload and valid stable; sink state must not advance.

modules.name: mv_ctrl_fsm
modules.responsibility: job control, counters, ready generation, error checks

modules.name: mv_vec_buffer
modules.responsibility: store vector and provide 16-lane read slices

ports.name: rd_data
ports.semantics: concatenated 16 INT8 lane values, combinational read

modules.name: mv_mac16_core
modules.responsibility: 16-lane multiply and reduction with row accumulator

ports.name: new_row
ports.semantics: pulse clears accumulator for new row

modules.name: mv_postproc
modules.responsibility: bias add, relu, output hold under backpressure

modules.name: mv_stream_if
modules.responsibility: channel handshake adaptation and packed-lane extraction

functional: For each job, output y[r] equals optional ReLU(optional bias + sum_k(W[r,k]*x[k])) with signed INT8 inputs and signed INT32 arithmetic.
If bias_enable=0, bias channel transfers are illegal and must assert status_error.
If relu_enable=0, negative outputs are allowed unchanged.
Output beat count equals M and order is strictly r=0..M-1.
verification: Minimum 100 randomized jobs across legal M,N ranges including N not multiple of 16.
Reset test required: assert/deassert rst_n mid-idle and mid-job; design returns to deterministic IDLE with status_error=0.
Backpressure tests required on all ready/valid channels with random ready toggling; no loss/duplication.
Completion behavior: busy rises after command acceptance and drops only after final output transfer.
Error behavior tests: out-of-range M/N, wrong stream lengths, forbidden bias traffic when disabled, missing bias when enabled.
rtl: All described behavior implementable in synthesizable SystemVerilog only; no forbidden constructs (real/shortreal/delay/force/class).
Ready/valid rule enforced: transfer iff ready&&valid; payload stable while stalled.
Parameter legality checks present for LANES==16 and width consistency constraints.
fpga_handoff: Vivado synthesis results accepted only from deterministic tool report matching required schema.
No estimated/inferred PPA metrics allowed without authoritative deterministic report.
Handoff requires verified RTL passing functional/regression criteria before synthesis.

diagnosis.root_cause: In mv_npu_top/mv_postproc integration, completed row results are presented with pp_in_valid from hold_row_valid, but mv_postproc only consumes when (!bias_en || bias_valid). For bias_en=0, acceptance can still be blocked because in_ready depends on out_valid/out_ready; if out_valid is held and out_ready toggles low, hold_row_valid may remain asserted, which directly deasserts mat_ready (gated by !hold_row_valid), causing matrix ingress timeout. This control coupling also perturbs row handoff timing and leads to arithmetic mismatch in directed case.

evidence.observation: Assertion failure at 34ns: got [3, -52] vs expected [3, -55].
evidence.relevance: Earliest authoritative functional divergence before timeout symptoms.

evidence.observation: SimTimeoutError timeout waiting mat_ready during matrix send.
evidence.relevance: Confirms progress failure under runtime backpressure/handshake sequences.

evidence.observation: mat_ready is gated by !hold_row_valid; hold_row_valid is set on last chunk and cleared only when pp_in_ready.
evidence.relevance: Direct mechanism for ingress stall when postproc acceptance is delayed.

evidence.observation: Row consume/write requires in_valid && in_ready and conditional (!bias_en || bias_valid); in_ready depends on out_valid/out_ready.
evidence.relevance: Explains coupling of row acceptance to output backpressure and possible retention of hold_row_valid.

alternative_hypotheses: Latch warnings in mv_mac16_core combinational temporaries could cause value corruption, but current first causal control divergence is localized to top-level row/postproc handshake.
Width-truncation warnings may affect large-N addressing but do not explain immediate directed mismatch and mat_ready stall at small N.

repair_plan.recommended_change: In mv_npu_top, refactor row-completion handoff to a strict one-entry decoupling buffer between compute and postproc: (1) capture final_row_sum only on accepted last matrix chunk, (2) drive pp_in_valid solely from buffered-valid state, (3) clear buffered-valid only on confirmed postproc input acceptance event, and (4) make mat_ready depend on compute phase/resource availability without circular dependence that can permanently block matrix ingress. Ensure bias-disabled rows are accepted without requiring bias_valid, and preserve transfer-on-ready&&valid semantics on all channels.
do_not_change: Do not modify frozen tests/reference artifacts.
Do not alter architecture behavior, arithmetic semantics, or lane packing conventions.
Do not change top-level port list, widths, or ready/valid protocol definitions.
Do not edit protected modules; localize fix to mv_npu_top integration/control logic.
expected_side_effects: Eliminates mat_ready timeout in randomized matrix ingress.
Stabilizes row-to-postproc transfer timing under out_ready backpressure.
May expose any remaining arithmetic-only defects after handshake repair; requires full rerun.

verification_context.user_request: Design an NPU for accelerating matrix-vector multiplication in neural-network inference. Use 16 parallel INT8 multiply-accumulate units, INT32 accumulators, optional bias addition, and selectable ReLU activation. The accelerator should accept input data and return results through ready/valid streaming interfaces.

design.name: mv_npu_rv16_int8
design.description: Matrix-vector inference accelerator using 16 parallel INT8 MAC lanes, INT32 accumulation, optional INT32 bias add, optional ReLU, ready/valid streaming I/O.

operations.name: op_decode_command
operations.semantics: Latch one command packet on cmd channel transfer; defines one job parameters and feature enables.

operations.name: op_load_vector
operations.semantics: Load input vector elements x[0..N-1] into local vector SRAM in ascending index order, using N from obj_job_config.

operations.name: op_compute_row_dot
operations.semantics: For each row r in 0..M-1, compute sum_{k=0..N-1}(W[r,k]*x[k]) with INT8 signed multiply and INT32 signed accumulation. Products are exact 16-bit signed then sign-extended to INT32 before add. Accumulation wraps modulo 2^32 (two's complement).

operations.name: op_optional_bias
operations.semantics: If bias_enable=1, y_pre = row_accum + bias[r] using INT32 signed add with wrap modulo 2^32; else y_pre = row_accum.

operations.name: op_optional_relu
operations.semantics: If relu_enable=1, y = max(0,y_pre) in INT32 signed domain; else y = y_pre.

data_types.name: dt_int8
data_types.conversion_semantics: No implicit conversion on transport; compute sign-extends for multiply inputs.

dimensions.semantic: number of matrix rows / output elements per job; runtime legal range 1..MAX_M bounded by parameter MAX_M

dimensions.name: dim_N

compute.dataflow: row-stationary accumulation; vector preloaded once per job, matrix streamed row-major during compute
compute.parallelism: 16-way inner-product parallelism across k dimension chunks of 16
compute.scheduling: phased: command load -> vector preload -> per-row compute (stream matrix chunks) -> optional bias consume -> optional ReLU -> output emit; no overlap between jobs

import random
import cocotb
from cocotb.triggers import Timer
from cocotb.triggers import SimTimeoutError

from reference.mv_npu_ref import golden_outputs, pack_cmd, pack_mat_beat_lanes

SEED = 12345

async def cycle(dut):
    dut.clk.value = 0
    await Timer(1, units='ns')
    pre = {
        'cmd_ready': int(dut.cmd_ready.value), 'vec_ready': int(dut.vec_ready.value),
        'mat_ready': int(dut.mat_ready.value), 'bias_ready': int(dut.bias_ready.value),
        'out_valid': int(dut.out_valid.value), 'out_data': int(dut.out_data.value.signed_integer),
        'busy': int(dut.status_busy.value), 'err': int(dut.status_error.value),
    }
    dut.clk.value = 1
    await Timer(1, units='ns')
    post = {
        'out_valid': int(dut.out_valid.value), 'out_data': int(dut.out_data.value.signed_integer),
        'busy': int(dut.status_busy.value), 'err': int(dut.status_error.value),
    }
    return pre, post

async def reset(dut):
    dut.cmd_valid.value = 0; dut.vec_valid.value = 0; dut.mat_valid.value = 0; dut.bias_valid.value = 0; dut.out_ready.value = 0
    dut.cmd_data.value = 0; dut.vec_data.value = 0; dut.mat_data.value = 0; dut.bias_data.value = 0
    dut.rst_n.value = 0
    for _ in range(3):
        await cycle(dut)
    dut.rst_n.value = 1
    for _ in range(3):
        await cycle(dut)

async def send_beat(dut, valid_sig, ready_sig, data_sig, data, max_wait=500):
    valid_sig.value = 1
    data_sig.value = data
    for _ in range(max_wait):
        pre, _ = await cycle(dut)
        if pre[ready_sig] == 1:
            valid_sig.value = 0
            return
    raise SimTimeoutError(f'timeout waiting {ready_sig}')

@cocotb.test()
async def test_directed_basic(dut):
    await reset(dut)
    M, N = 2, 5
    vec = [1, -2, 3, -4, 5]
    mat = [[1,1,1,1,1], [-1,2,-3,4,-5]]
    exp = golden_outputs(M, N, vec, mat, 0, 0, [])
    await send_beat(dut, dut.cmd_valid, 'cmd_ready', dut.cmd_data, pack_cmd(M, N, 0, 0))
    for x in vec:
        await send_beat(dut, dut.vec_valid, 'vec_ready', dut.vec_data, x & 0xFF)
    chunks = (N + 15)//16
    for r in range(M):
        for c in range(chunks):
            base = 16*c
            lanes = [mat[r][base+i] if base+i < N else 0 for i in range(16)]
            await send_beat(dut, dut.mat_valid, 'mat_ready', dut.mat_data, pack_mat_beat_lanes(lanes))
    dut.out_ready.value = 1
    got = []
    for _ in range(5000):
        pre, _ = await cycle(dut)
        if pre['out_valid'] and int(dut.out_ready.value):
            got.append(pre['out_data'])
            if len(got) == M:
                break
    assert got == exp

@cocotb.test()
async def test_randomized_100_jobs(dut):
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    await reset(dut)
    jobs = 100
    for j in range(jobs):
        M = rng.randint(1, 16)
        N = rng.randint(1, 31)
        bias_en = rng.randint(0,1)
        relu_en = rng.randint(0,1)
        vec = [rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(N)]
        mat = [[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(N)] for _ in range(M)]
        bias = [rng.randint(-(1<<31),(1<<31)-1) for _ in range(M)] if bias_en else []
        exp = golden_outputs(M,N,vec,mat,bias_en,relu_en,bias)
        await send_beat(dut, dut.cmd_valid, 'cmd_ready', dut.cmd_data, pack_cmd(M,N,bias_en,relu_en))
        for x in vec: await send_beat(dut, dut.vec_valid, 'vec_ready', dut.vec_data, x & 0xFF)
        for r in range(M):
            for c in range((N+15)//16):
                lanes = [mat[r][16*c+i] if 16*c+i < N else 0 for i in range(16)]
                await send_beat(dut, dut.mat_valid, 'mat_ready', dut.mat_data, pack_mat_beat_lanes(lanes))
        if bias_en:
            for b in bias: await send_beat(dut, dut.bias_valid, 'bias_ready', dut.bias_data, b & 0xFFFFFFFF)
        got=[]
        for _ in range(20000):
            dut.out_ready.value = rng.randint(0,1)
            pre,_=await cycle(dut)
            if pre['out_valid'] and int(dut.out_ready.value):
                got.append(pre['out_data'])
                if len(got)==M: break
        assert got==exp, f'job={j} seed={SEED}'
